newsitem.title: USA: Equitable mulls options for real estate unit.
newsitem.headline: Equitable mulls options for real estate unit.

text.p: The Equitable Cos Inc said on Friday that it and its Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc unit were exploring strategic alternatives for Equitable Real Estate, a leading manager of pension fund assets invested in real estate.
Although discussions have begun looking toward a possible sale, no definitive agreement has been executed at this time, the company said.
The company said that it had no comment beyond the statement released concerning discussions.

George Puskar, Equitable Real Estate's chairman and chief executive officer, said its goal was to enter a strategic alliance with a preeminent company that would enhance its position among real estate managers.

"As Equitable continues to reduce its real estate portfolio and Equitable Real Estate continues to expand dynamically its investment management and property management businesses, the time has come to look at unlocking the value of Equitable Real Estate," Joseph Melone, Equitable Cos president and chief executive officer, said.
Equitable and Equitable Real Estate said that neither company expected to have further comment until they reached a final determination on a potential sale.
